16/S0.subgoal: Explain the importance of tracking in XR systems and the distinction between tracking and sensing.

16/S1.subgoal: Categorize tracking by what is being tracked and describe the specific use cases for each category.

16/S2.subgoal: Describe the differences between inside-out and outside-in tracking based on the location of sensors.

16/S3.subgoal: Explain the four primary stages of the tracking process: calibration, registration, integration, and drift correction.

16/S4.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
